revision: r4 (2026-11-10): r3 + the owner's narrator-first rules (main docs/stories.md): one kid narrator (cast `narrator`, Leda) carries the story; Grandpa's own voice only for his two on-screen punchlines (L09, L13, 6 words or fewer); L04 quoted with a said tag; L01 in one breath; r4.2: narrator re-voiced with the Pip recipe (owner pick, supersedes kid Puck), cut at the quietest point (fixed resplit)
caption: why do raiders always follow grandpa home 😶
logline: A boy's grandpa has saved their village from thirty-one raids, and every one started the night he came home; the night Grandpa comes home too tired to fight, the boy drinks Grandpa's 'courage' himself.
question: why tf do raids start every night grandpa comes home?
premise: Grandpa keeps a totem from every raid he has saved the village from: 31 on his wall, and one empty frame. Every raid started the night he came home; he says they follow him because he beats them. The villagers throw him bread when he walks by. He hunts at the old pillager tower on the hill and brings back grey bottles, a whole chest of them; he calls it his courage and drinks it at the gate, then tells the boy to lock the door. Since Grandma died, a raid is the only time anyone is glad to see him.
twist: The 'courage' is an ominous bottle: drinking it gives Bad Omen, and a player with it in a village starts a raid. Grandpa has been bringing every raid himself, so the village will need him. Tonight he comes home too tired to fight and leaves the bottle undrunk; the boy, sure a raid is coming anyway, drinks it so somebody can fight. The raid horn sounds, pillagers and a ravager come up the road, and Grandpa stands beside him loading his crossbow: 'Now they'll love you too, kid.'

lines.text: Grandpa has saved / our village / from THIRTY-ONE / RAIDS.
lines.direction: bright and quick, all in one breath, a proud grin

lines.text: Every single one / started the night / he came HOME.
lines.direction: quick, the grin fading on the last word

lines.text: Grandpa said, / "They know / who BEATS them."
lines.direction: doing a gruff grandpa impression, proud, quick

lines.text: When he / walks by, / the villagers / throw him BREAD.
He hunts at / the old TOWER / on the hill.
He brings back / grey BOTTLES. / He's got / a whole CHEST.
He calls it / his COURAGE. / He drinks it / at the GATE.
Lock the DOOR, / kid. / They're COMING.
lines.say: Lock the door, kid. They're coming.
lines.direction: calm and certain, almost bored; he knows exactly when

lines.text: Since Grandma died, / a RAID / is the only time / anyone's GLAD / to see him.
lines.say: Since Grandma died a raid is the only time anyone's glad to see him.
lines.direction: still quick, but the grin is gone; a little sad

lines.text: Tonight / he came home / too TIRED / to fight.

lines.text: So I drank / his COURAGE. / Somebody / had to FIGHT.
lines.say: So I drank his courage. Somebody had to fight.

lines.text: Now they'll / love YOU / too, kid.

lines.direction: dry and tired, a grim little pride; plain voice, never a whisper

shots.camera: pov just inside the door, slow push to the north wall
shots.frame: establishing the room (inside 9 E-W x 7 N-S x 5 high): the north wall of item frames, 4 rows of 8 at heights 1-4 above the floor; Grandpa at frame RIGHT, back three-quarters to us, puts the 31st totem of undying into the bottom row's 7th frame on 'THIRTY-ONE'; beside his hand the one EMPTY frame (bottom row, last, the 32nd), lit by a lantern standing on the floor directly under it; the push ends on 'RAIDS' with the empty frame in the lower third. Morning light through the east window. Dawn after raid 31 (23500).

shots.camera: pov high on the palisade by the east gate at dusk, looking east down the road, a slow drift
shots.frame: fg: the palisade's log tops; subject: Grandpa small on the road walking home toward the gate, alone, crossbow in hand; bg: fields, the river, and on the far ridge the dark pillager tower against the sky. Dusk (12400).

shots.camera: pov at the yard's west side, about (-14,-4) from the gate, looking east, still
shots.frame: establishing the yard: fg: the yard fence; subject: Grandpa at his grindstone at about (-6,-4), working, crossbow-less (both hands on the work: the main hand empty); his door at frame left, the gate posts at frame right about 22 degrees off; the crossbow hangs in an item frame on the wall by his door. Evening (12600), the same evening he came home.

shots.camera: pov a few steps closer, 3.5 blocks from him, slightly lower
shots.frame: fg: the grindstone's edge; subject: Grandpa knees up, not looking up, the crossbow frame on the wall beside his door; bg: his door and the yard fence. Evening (12600).

shots.camera: pov at the edge of the square, slow push as Grandpa crosses left to right
shots.frame: fg: a fence and a hay bale low; subject: Grandpa walking across the square, crossbow in hand, farmers stepping up to throw bread at him on 'BREAD' (items arcing to him); bg: the bell, houses, the butcher's roof with a fresh hole in it (raid 31's damage, no smoke). Dawn after raid 31 (23800).

shots.camera: pov on the slope below the ridge at sunset, looking up
shots.frame: fg: tall grass and a birch; subject: the pillager tower (outpost) on the ridge; Grandpa's small figure climbing the path toward it; bg: the sky. Sunset (12000), another day.

shots.camera: pov beside Grandpa at the open chest
shots.frame: Grandpa at the chest under the east window, the bottle coming up in his hand on 'BOTTLES' (camera beside him); on 'CHEST' first person: Milo opens the chest and the chest screen shows it full of ominous bottles. Night (14000), lantern-lit.

shots.camera: pov 4 blocks behind Grandpa and 2 blocks south, inside the gate, at dusk (the 180-degree side the bible uses)
shots.frame: fg: the gate's log posts; subject: Grandpa standing in the open gate in profile-three-quarters, the ominous bottle in his right hand; on 'drinks' the drink pose, bottle to his mouth, head back (drink sound); on 'GATE' the bottle is gone and the crossbow is in his hand; bg: the road into the dusk and the ridge with the tower. Dusk (13000), a typical raid night.

shots.camera: pov 3.5 blocks behind him, south of the line; Grandpa turns his head over his right shoulder
shots.frame: subject: Grandpa knees up between the gate posts, turning to look back at the camera, the bottle gone (drunk), the crossbow in his hand; bg: the road and the dark ridge. Dusk (13000).

shots.camera: pov from the room's south-east corner, still, then a slow drift
shots.frame: fg: Grandma's chair (pushed in), nearest the lens; subject: Grandpa sitting in his chair at the table set for two (one bowl), head down; he lifts his head once on 'GLAD'; bg: the totem wall. Night (14000), another night.

shots.camera: pov in the yard, 7 blocks from his door, a slow push
shots.frame: the final night, visibly different: not at the gate. fg: the yard fence; subject: Grandpa slumped on the bench by his door, head down, dozing, an ominous bottle undrunk in his slack hand; the crossbow hangs in its frame on the wall beside him; on 'FIGHT' the bottle leaves his hand and is in mine (the first-person hand comes up with it at the end of the push); bg: the open gate posts at frame right, the ridge darkening. Dusk (12300).

shots.camera: pov at the open gate, the bottle in hand, raising it to drink
shots.frame: fg: the ominous bottle in the first-person hand (HUD: the bottle selected); subject: the open gate posts and the empty road ahead running east into the dusk; bg: the ridge and the tower. The first-person drink starts on 'drank' (1.6 s) and the bottle is gone by 'Somebody'; 'had to FIGHT' as I look back at Grandpa asleep at his door. Dusk (12400).

shots.camera: pov at the gate, still, a slow push up the road; 1.8 s
shots.frame: the reveal: the raid horn on frame 1; up the road, 20 blocks out and walking to 16, five pillagers (crossbows) and a ravager coming toward the gate; no torches, no banners (staged: vanilla's wave 1 is 4 pillagers with a bannered captain and ravagers come from wave 3; we show the threat, not wave 1); fg: the gate posts; bg: the fields and the ridge, the sky darkening. Dusk (13000: the raid starts 30 s after the drink; the cut carries it).

shots.camera: pov turns about 25 degrees right, from east to east-south-east
shots.frame: subject: Grandpa, waist up (MS, 2.8 blocks), standing 2 blocks east and 2 south of the boy, just outside the south gate post, awake, his own crossbow in hand, eyes on the road; he loads it (the crossbow loading sounds, an arm pump) and glances at the camera on 'YOU'; at about +23 degrees, frame right; bg (frame left, about -22 degrees): the raiders 13-16 blocks up the road, the ravager biggest. Cut 0.3 s after 'kid'. Dusk (13000).

payoff_note: the payoff is Grandpa's "kid" with the crossbow's loaded click, over the raiders up the road (the horn reveal 2 s before is the build to it)
